items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Johnny used to come out when I worked out at the peak in Inman. Johnny used to come out every now and then play, you know, client. But he played good client there too. Johnny played real good.

ctx.x: I was going to ask you, it had Imperial Jazz on the drum, in that picture of Johnny Batusi's band? Yeah. And Ellis is playing the drums, Ellis Stratikas.
That's what they tell me, well that's Johnny, Johnny's put the names on there, see.
Oh yeah, I see. Yeah, Johnny put the names on there.
